incidents.summary: B&M was fined £2 million in July 2026 for food hygiene failures involving mouse infestations at three Birmingham stores.

sources.title: B&M fined £2m after mouse infestations caused enforced shutdowns - Retail Gazette
sources.quote: Alongside the £2m fine, B&M was ordered to pay £18,104 in prosecution costs and a £2,000 victim surcharge.

sources.title: B&M fined £2 million following Birmingham City Council prosecution over serious food hygiene failings | Birmingham City Council
sources.quote: Officers found significant evidence of mouse activity, including mouse droppings and gnawed food products on sale.

sources.title: B&M fined £2m over mice infestations at Birmingham stores - BBC News
sources.quote: B&M said it was "deeply sorry for the failings identified" and had taken comprehensive action to "strengthen controls across our business".

incidents.summary: B&M was fined £1 million after an electrician suffered serious burns in an electrical explosion at its Liverpool warehouse in September 2018.

sources.title: Retailer B&M fined £1m for safety breaches at its Liverpool warehouse
sources.quote: Liverpool-based discount retailer B&M, has been fined £1m after an electrician suffered serious burns to 15% of his body when he was caught in an explosion at a warehouse in Liverpool.

sources.title: Retailer B&M fined £1m for safety breaches at its Liverpool warehouse
sources.quote: On September 22, 2018, an electrician was using a metal spanner to repair an electrical fault at a B&M Retail Ltd warehouse, in Speke, South Liverpool.

incidents.summary: Burberry filed a High Court lawsuit against B&M alleging trademark infringement and misrepresentation of products as associated with Burberry.

sources.title: Burberry Sues B&M Over Furberry - Lux Juris
sources.quote: Burberry has officially launched legal action against B&M, alleging trademark infringement and claiming that B&M has misrepresented its products as associated with the renowned luxury brand.

sources.title: Burberry Sues B&M Over Furberry - Lux Juris
sources.quote: The lawsuit was filed in London’s High Court on December 2, 2024.
